title: Cube of a number
error_pattern: Return value (returned value from function call is discarded)
description: Write a program that reads an integer n, uses the function cube() to compute n*n*n, and prints the result. Example: 4 prints 64.

seeded_bug.root_cause: cube() returns the correct value, but the caller never stores it, so answer keeps its initial value 0.

checkpoints.prediction_prompt: What value do you think result holds right before cube() returns?

checkpoints.location: in main(), after the call to cube(n) (line 16)
checkpoints.prediction_prompt: What value do you think answer holds after cube(n) has been called?
